What weft has installed in a project

Source: R/use-weft.R
status.Rd

Reports the state of each part of the set-up: setup (_weft.yml and the version it records), activation, quarto, dictionary, hooks, ci, agent docs, draft, verify_skip and strict, and python (can import weft run) for a project with a jupyter-engine document. It writes nothing, starts no R process and uses no network.

Usage

status(path = ".")

Arguments

path

A directory in the project.

Value

A weft_status: a data frame with part, state and detail, and the attribute next.

Details

state is one of ok, missing, outdated (weft's file is from another version, or the hook's recorded Rscript has gone), edited (a file weft wrote has been changed by hand: it is left alone and never makes a next step), off (draft mode on, or parts of verify() skipped) and n/a. The next attribute is the first part, in the order of use_weft(), that is missing or outdated, as a sentence; otherwise it says there is nothing to install.
